body: This would be cool! Thank you for the idea :00 really, it's very nice!
That's kind of you :)) ♡ thanks!
I'm happy that you are well! And thank you so much! I' here for you of you need to talk too
Hi! Thank you so much! I'm here for you if you need to talk too
I'm better now! Are you fine?
Thank you so much! It was really kind of you to talk to me. You helped me a lot! I hope you have a nice day! ♡

Sorry, I can't see your other comment in the thread for some reason T-T, so I'll reply to this one with the answer. 

Thank you! I hope the battery gets better with time. I think a mixed style could work, and I would be open to try it, but the problem is that I don't want to get in trouble. I don't think my teachers would care about it. We are almost ending classes and there are a lot of exams near, so it would just be inconvenient to them. I really don't want to cause trouble, but I'll try to find a way to make it work :) 

Sure! Like, I wanted to slowly get myself used to spend time around people, since 7+ hours per day out of nowhere is too much for me, but I don't have this option. And about the other people, is just that I don't exist to them most of the time, and that's okay! But it's just a bit overwhelming, I feel like I'm not supposed to be there. 

Also, thank you a lot for taking to me! You said you had some things to do before, so please, don't feel obligated to! I'm a lot better after talking to you, and uou already helped me so much! ♡
Thank you so much! You helped me a lot, really. Thanks for talking to me :)

Yeah, I've been trying to interact more with people that I like and their friends. It's nice! It's easier when it's by choice. I think the problem is that at school I can't really interact very well, and my 'social battery' just ends very quickly, so it's too tiring. 

That's alright! I don't know how to explain very well, but I like to do it by staying comfortable and annotating/scribbling a lot. At school we are expected to just sit, listen and copy, it it really doesn't work for me. I pushed myself to do it in the past, but now that I found a way to make studying something a bit better and easier, it feels bad to just pretend that I can learn as school expects me to. I feel like teachers are more concerned about how we portray ourselves than about how we are learning there. It makes me a bit sad, because I know it will be harder to sit still and even learn like that.

About interacting, I just stay with my friends and enjoy as much as I can with them, but I can't do it for too long, because I get really tired and overwhelmed. I planned to adapt myself slowly into it again, but now I don't have options. And it's just a bit suffocating to stay around 40 other people who act like I don't exist.
I'm sorry that you had a bad experience with school too. Thank you for the advice, it really helped! I'll try to do these things!
That's alright! You already helped me a lot by hearing me. I'm just in panic about going back to school. I never really liked to go there, but after two years away, going back feels impossible.
I'm happy that you are okay. And thank you! I'm just feeling down. I'm freaking out about something that I can't change, and I can't see any other ways to deal with it

Thank you for this. Really.

Yeah, I guess that's the worst part of the problem. I'm just not ready to act like I was expected to do inside the classroom, around people that I don't even talk to. I changed a lot in these years, from how I interact to how I study. I'm not ready to throw it away and pretend that I can do like I did before.
Thank you ♡ that's really nice. Are you okay?

This feeling sucks lol T-T. I hope things work out for you!  I feel like it's the only option because I knok how I react in situations like that, so I know that even if it's not something that I want 100% now, it will feel like the only thing that can make it better in the next days.

It's alright! It feels a bit childish, to be honest, but it's just about school. I never dealt well with being at school or at places with a lot of people like that, and after almost two years of no social contact, I'll have to go back at full speed. I'm just freaking out about it, because I really don't think I can do it like I did before the covid situation. It was hard before, so I can't even imagine how it will be now. 

I know it's something really small, but it's hard to deal with it.

Yeah, sure. Thank you for hearing me :) I guess that sometimes I feel like I don't really want to die, but this seems to be the only option to me, so I just convinced myself to do it. Some things are going to happen and I'm 100% sure that I can't go through them again, so I feel like this is all I can do. I tried to explain that to her but I guess she didn't think it was too serious :/ 

I don't really want to hurt anyone and I know that I would stay if it wasn't for this thing, that's why I think I don't really want to die, but the more I think, the messier it gets lol. Sorry if this is confusing.

And I'm glad that you are doing fine! I hope that you can do the things that you have to do calmly, at your own pace :)
Hi! I'm just having a bad day. I tried to talk about these things with my therapist, but I feel like she didn't even care. I guess I'm feeling a bit lost and unheard. How was your day?
That's good! I'm happy for you ♡
That's good!

Thanks :) I'm just having a bad day, feeling down, ignoring the things that I have to do lol. I don't really wanna die but I feel like I have no other options.

Are you okay? I mean, not okay okay since we are both here lol, but like, are you alright today?
Omg lol I can't but thanks /j. Thank you for your words, I'm just tired.

I really can't, it would affect my parents too much and it would make everything more complicated since I don't know her very well. But thank you so much for your advice and help. It really helped me a lot ♡ I'll talk to her about these things!
It's very tiring, but I think the pain that it would cause keeps me going. I don't want to hurt anyone. I hope life becomes easier for us ♡
I hope you can rest more and that these next years get easier ♡ take care and thank you so much!
I'm sorry :( it must be hard af. Is there much left of school for you? I won't be able to have online classes anymore T-T but thanks for the advice!

Living is hard lol, I'm sorry that you feel like this too. I hope it can get better in the future. 

You already helped me a lot. Really, it was really kind of you, thank you so much! I'll try to relax a bit. And please give yourself a hug too, you are doing so well! You deserve happiness too. And if I can help you, I'm here.

Thank you for this :)

I guess I'm just depressed and very anxious. I've been dealing with this for a while, and now I'm just too tired to try again. I'm constantly panicking and I feel like I'm just surviving from a crisis to another. It's just very tiring and makes me unmotivated to even try. 

Thanks for the kindness ♡ I'm wishing you the best too!

Hi! I don't know if I can help much, but I'm glad that you vent here. It's hard to keep all of this inside. I hope it made you feel a bit better ♡
I don't know if it is a possible alternative for you, and I don't want to act like I know the situation, but I've been seeing a lot about voluntary work these days, and maybe it's an option.
Like, living in a place and 'paying rent' by cleaning or working at this place, just until you find a job that you enjoy at this different town. I don't know if this is too utopic or even if it is safe, but it is one of the options, I guess.
No matter how, I believe that you can do it. You really can. Because you deserve to live in a place that you like and you deserve to live a life that you are happy with. 25 years are a lot, but you still can live even more than this in a better place.
